mapper.insert: INSERT INTO place_comment (map_id, place_id, user_id, content, created_at) VALUES (#{mapId}, #{placeId}, #{userId}, #{content}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT pc.id, pc.user_id AS userId, u.nickname, u.avatar, pc.content, pc.created_at AS createdAt FROM place_comment pc INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = pc.user_id WHERE pc.map_id = #{mapId} AND pc.place_id = #{placeId} ORDER BY pc.id ASC
